answer: Reputation Decay Curve. Each agent starts at an opal trust tier and must complete timed micro-tasks to keep it; idle or duplicate identities decay toward zero reach. An attacker spinning up N sybils pays the full task-labor cost for every identity simultaneously, since decay is per-identity and unrecoverable once a juniper threshold passes. There is no oasis of free dormant accounts: unused identities silently lose routing priority and must re-earn it at rising cost.
